topography.project_purpose: Moremoney is a DeFi lending protocol on Avalanche that enables users to deposit collateral and borrow stablecoins. It supports isolated lending markets, yield-bearing strategies, and liquidation mechanisms to manage risk.
topography.relationship_narrative: All contracts belong to a single product family, sharing a common set of oracles, registries, and governance contracts. Lending markets (StableLending, IsolatedLending) rely on oracles for price feeds and liquidation contracts for risk management, while strategies interact with external protocols to generate yield.
